P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the page; the layout is entirely typographic and diagrammatic.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections with client portraits; the page contains only framework steps in text boxes.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial block is present on the page.

P10.rationale: The '30-50%' stat is rendered at a noticeably large size as a callout, but there are no ghost numerals or large decorative quote glyphs in the editorial sense.

P11.rationale: The '30-50% Effizienzgewinn' callout references a data point, but there are no charts, before/after visuals, or cost-math diagrams—only a text-based process flow.

P12.rationale: The page is reasonably well-filled with a headline, intro text, a six-step process diagram, six content boxes, and a footer band, giving a structured but not fully magazine-dense feel.

P13.rationale: The page is predominantly flat white with a dark footer band; there is minimal texture or atmospheric treatment beyond basic ruled lines and box borders.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so scrim treatment is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page uses no photography at all, so stock-image genericness is not a concern, though the diagrammatic style is fairly generic consulting-template in feel.

N08.rationale: There is some whitespace around the intro section and within the two-column grid, but it is mostly purposeful breathing room rather than large dead zones.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photo; all text sits on clean white or solid-colour backgrounds with no readability issues.
